在损伤得到解决之前，方舟舰的结构强度无法安全支持高速机动。因此，航行部门已实施严格的速度限制，以防止裂纹进一步扩大。

我们可以尝试进行快速现场维修以稳固受损部位，或者指派一艘后勤船进行全面的结构大修。

texts.zh:
最近在[Root.GetName]上安装的轴基挂载武器对舰船前部结构造成的压力远超最初预期。工程检查发现，从挂载部主要锚点向外延伸的应力裂纹已扩散至周围的船体装甲板。

在损伤得到解决之前，方舟舰的结构强度无法安全支持高速机动。因此，航行部门已实施严格的速度限制，以防止裂纹进一步扩大。

我们可以尝试进行快速现场维修以稳固受损部位，或者指派一艘后勤船进行全面的结构大修。
texts.en:
The recently installed Spinal Mount aboard [Root.GetName] has placed greater strain on the vessel's forward structure than originally anticipated. Engineering inspections have uncovered a network of stress fractures radiating from the mount's primary anchor points, spreading across the surrounding hull plating.

Until the damage is addressed, the Arkship's structural integrity cannot safely support high-velocity maneuvering. Navigation has therefore imposed severe speed restrictions to prevent the fractures from widening.

We may attempt rapid field repairs to stabilize the damage, or assign a Logistics Ship to conduct a full structural overhaul.

label.en: Stabilize the fractures and move on.

label.zh: 我们要妥善处理这个情况。

texts.zh:
[event_target:fractured_spine_arkship.GetName]的轴基挂载武器修复工作已经完成。虽然维修过程需要精细的作业和长时间的检查，但我们借此机会加固了舰体多处薄弱部位，并改良了挂架的结构支撑。

这些改进提升了方舟舰在高难度机动时的稳定性，使得导航部门得以解除此前的航行限制。初步测试表明，该舰现在的性能表现比受损前更加出色。
texts.en:
Repairs to the Spinal Mount of [event_target:fractured_spine_arkship.GetName] have been completed. Though the process required careful work and extended inspections, we used the opportunity to reinforce several vulnerable sections of the hull and refine the mount's structural supports.

The resulting improvements have increased the Arkship's stability during high-speed maneuvers, allowing navigation to lift previous restrictions. Early tests suggest the vessel now performs more efficiently than before the damage occurred.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]舰上引擎突然发生的激增使方舟舰的驱动核心超出了安全运行公差。热点正在主引擎组件中蔓延，压力上升的速度超过了调节系统的补偿能力。

如果不加控制，过剩的输出可能会损坏关键的引擎部件。我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]建议了几种可能的对策：排放多余的等离子体以稳定系统，重新分配工作任务优先级，或者暂时关闭引擎进行全面重新校准。
texts.en:
A sudden engine surge aboard [Root.GetName] has pushed the Arkship's drive core beyond safe operating tolerances. Heat blooms are spreading through the primary engine assembly, and pressure is rising faster than the regulation systems can compensate.

If left unchecked, the excess output could damage critical engine components. Our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] recommend several possible responses: vent the excess plasma to stabilize the system, reprioritize work assignments, or temporarily shut the engines down to conduct a full recalibration.

label.zh: 关闭引擎，重新进行校准。
label.en: Shut the engines down and recalibrate.

texts.zh:
多余的等离子体已通过受控排放排出，在方舟舰的舰艉洒下灿烂的光幕。引擎压力已恢复至正常水平，未记录到永久性损伤。

不过，此次排放留下了一层宝贵的带电粒子残余物，其中大部分已被成功回收并汇入我们的储备。
texts.en:
The excess plasma was vented in a controlled discharge, spilling brilliant sheets of light across the Arkship's stern. Engine pressure has returned to acceptable levels, and no lasting damage was recorded.

The release did, however, leave behind a valuable residue of energized particles, much of which has been successfully recovered and routed into our reserves.

texts.zh:
在过去的六个月里，[Root.GetName]上的维修人员马不停蹄地工作，力求让方舟舰过热的驱动系统恢复控制。在引擎持续运行的情况下，他们拆除了检修面板，重新布置了冷却管线，并更换了受损的调节器。

这些努力目前已经稳定了驱动核心，负责这项工作的船员们为此忍受了长时间的轮班和恶劣的工作环境。尽管疲惫不堪，但士气依然高涨。无论虚空给我们将带来什么，我们都有信心能够承受。
texts.en:
For the past six months, repair crews on [Root.GetName] have worked without pause to bring the Arkship's overheating drive systems back under control. Access panels were stripped away, coolant lines rerouted, and damaged regulators replaced while the engines continued to run.

The effort has stabilized the drive core for now, though the crews responsible endured long shifts and harsh working conditions to make it happen. Despite their exhaustion, morale is high. Whatever the void throws at us, we are confident we can endure it.

texts.zh:
在过去的六个月里，维护子个体在不间断地运行，以使方舟舰过热的驱动系统恢复控制。在发动机持续运转的情况下，检修面板被拆除，冷却液管道被重新布线，受损的调节器也得到了更换。

虽然该行动需要子个体在多个系统子模块中持续作业，但这一过程也揭示了发动机组件中的几处结构性缺陷。这些问题现已得到修正，整体运行效率有了显著提升。无论虚空带来怎样的压力，我们都将适应。
texts.en:
For the past six months, maintenance drones have operated without interruption to bring the Arkship's overheating drive systems back under control. Access panels were removed, coolant conduits rerouted, and damaged regulators replaced while the engines continued to run.

Though the operation required sustained drone activity across multiple subsystems, the process revealed several structural inefficiencies in the engine assembly. These have now been corrected, and overall operational efficiency has measurably improved. Whatever stresses the void may impose, we will adapt.

texts.zh:
发动机按受控阶段逐步关停，以便我们的工程师在安全条件下检查驱动组件并重新校准其调节系统。虽然这一过程延误了行程，但关停期间收集的数据已证明具有重要价值。

我们已查明[Root.GetName]核心定序中的几处效率低下问题。通过重定向多余能量并加固结构支撑，我们增强了方舟舰的护盾与船壳，使其足以抵御未来的压力。
texts.en:
The engines were brought down in controlled stages, allowing our engineers to inspect the drive assembly under safe conditions and recalibrate its regulation systems. The process delayed us, but the data gathered during the shutdown has already proven valuable.

Several inefficiencies in the core sequencing on [Root.GetName] have been identified. By redirecting surplus energy and reinforcing structural supports, our we have strengthened both the Arkship's shields and hull against future strain.

texts.zh:
一个故障的继电器正在干扰方舟舰[Root.GetName]的能源核心。除了无法动弹之外，住宅区的灯光也正在熄灭。农场报告能源涌动异常，几个关键研究模块已经离线。

我们的总工程师警告说，如果不加以干预，连锁故障将蔓延至整艘飞船。不幸的是，解决方案并不简单。修复继电器需要从储备中抽调资源，而绕过它则有损害方舟舰长期稳定性的风险。

冷却中的飞船发出令人不安的吱嘎声和呻吟声。我们现在需要做出决定。
texts.en:
A faulty relay is interfering with the Arkship [Root.GetName]'s power core. In addition to being immobilized, the lights are now going out on residential decks. Farms report irregular energy surges, and several key research modules have gone offline.

Our chief engineers warn that without intervention, cascading failures will spread throughout the ship. Unfortunately the solution is not straightforward. Repairing the relay will require diverting resources from our reserves, while bypassing it risks compromising the Arkship's long-term stability.

The cooling ship creaks and groans unsettlingly. We need to make a decision now.

label.zh: 不惜一切代价，把它修好。
label.en: Spare no expense and repair it properly.

label.zh: 修修补补继续用吧，我们现在得勒紧裤腰带过日子。
label.en: Patch it and move on. We cannot afford luxuries.

texts.zh: 尽管困难重重，方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的工程船员不仅修复了故障继电器，还对其进行了改进。现在，全舰的能量分配比以往任何时候都更加顺畅，多年来一直不稳定的系统也得以稳定。船员士气大幅提升，许多人对方舟舰的韧性表现出了新的自豪感。
texts.en: Against all odds, the engineering crew on Arkship [Root.GetName] has not only repaired the faulty relay, but improved it. Energy distribution across the ship is now smoother than ever, stabilizing systems that have been temperamental for years. Crew morale has risen sharply, with many expressing newfound pride in the Arkship's resilience.

texts.zh: 对飞船[Root.GetName]能源核心的快速修复暂时有效。但临时旁路电路在持续使用下已不堪重负。频繁的全船断电已成为常态，一些区域的环境控制在过热和过冷之间摇摆不定。船员抱怨领导层选择了权宜之计而非安全。低语流传着，方舟舰正在变成一座修修补补的遗迹，而非一座坚韧的灯塔。
texts.en: The quick fix on the Arkship [Root.GetName]'s power core is holding, at least for now. But the makeshift bypass circuits are straining under constant use. Frequent ship-wide blackouts are now a way of life, and environmental controls in some sections have been oscillating between too hot, and too cold. The crew grumble that leadership chose expedience over security. Whispers circulate that the Arkship is becoming a patchwork relic, rather than a beacon of endurance.

label.en: We must make do and mend.

texts.zh:
方舟舰的轴基挂载武器安装工作已导致舰船前部体产生危险的结构应力。

我们将派遣一艘后勤船，全面加固受影响的区域。
texts.en:
The installation of the Arkship's Spinal Mount has introduced dangerous structural stresses along the vessel's forward hull.

A Logistics Ship will be dispatched to fully reinforce the affected sections.
